title: DISABLE TRIGGER
description: Learn how to temporarily disable triggers using the DISABLE TRIGGER statement.

data.text: The DISABLE TRIGGER statement temporarily disables a trigger so that it does not fire when associated events occur. This is useful for troubleshooting or bulk data operations.

data.title: Disable a single trigger
data.content: Disables a specific DML trigger on a table.
data.code:
DISABLE TRIGGER [schema_name.][trigger_name]
ON [object_name | DATABASE | ALL SERVER]

data.title: Disable all triggers on a table
data.content: Disables all triggers on the specified table.

data.title: DISABLE TRIGGER Key Points
points: Use DISABLE TRIGGER to temporarily prevent a trigger from firing.
Disabling a trigger does not remove its definition.
You can disable all triggers on a table or database at once.
Use ENABLE TRIGGER to re-enable a disabled trigger.
